body.name: \overline R_{x,n}(\widetilde q_x;\alpha)
body.construction: \(\overline R_{x,n}(\widetilde q_x;\alpha)=\sup_{p\in\mathcal C_n(\alpha)}\max_{b\in\mathcal A}h_{\mathcal M_x(p_x)}(e_b-\widetilde q_x)\), augmented by the reported primal--dual solver gap when the supremum is computed numerically.
